Job Description: Non-IT Recruiter

**Job Title:** Non-IT Recruiter  
**Location:** Noida, Uttar Pradesh  
**Experience:** 2–5 Years  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time  
**Industry:** IT Services / Cloud / Data Center / Enterprise Solutions

About the Role

We are looking for an experienced and result-oriented **Non-IT Recruiter** with 2–5 years of experience in end-to-end recruitment, particularly in hiring for IT Sales, Cloud Sales, Data Center, Enterprise Sales, Government Sales, Inside Sales, Pre-Sales Infrastructure, and Business Development roles.

The ideal candidate should have strong sourcing skills, a good understanding of IT infrastructure and technology sales profiles, and the ability to close positions within defined timelines.

Key Responsibilities

* Manage the complete recruitment lifecycle, from sourcing and screening to interview coordination, offer negotiation, and onboarding.
* Source candidates for specialized positions across:
* Data Center Sales and Data Center Solutions
* Cloud Sales (AWS, Azure, GCP)
* IT Sales and Enterprise Sales
* Government Sales / PSU Sales
* Inside Sales and Lead Generation
* Pre-Sales – IT Infrastructure and Cloud Solutions
* Business Development Manager (BDM)
* System Integration (SI) and IT Solutions Sales
* Identify and attract candidates through Naukri, LinkedIn, Indeed, referrals, and other recruitment platforms.
* Understand job requirements and coordinate with hiring managers to identify suitable candidates.
* Conduct initial screening to evaluate communication skills, relevant industry experience, salary expectations, notice period, and overall suitability.
* Maintain a strong candidate pipeline and ensure timely closures against assigned requirements.
* Coordinate interviews with technical panels, sales heads, and senior management.
* Negotiate salary packages and manage offer rollouts and joining follow-ups.
* Maintain recruitment MIS, trackers, and daily/weekly hiring reports.
* Build and maintain a database of qualified candidates for current and future requirements.

Required Skills & Qualifications

* 2–5 years of experience in end-to-end recruitment.
* Prior experience in hiring for IT Sales, Cloud Sales, Data Center, Enterprise Sales, or Government Sales roles is highly preferred.
* Good understanding of IT infrastructure, cloud solutions, data center services, and enterprise technology sales profiles.
* Strong hands-on experience with Naukri, LinkedIn Recruiter, Indeed, and Boolean search techniques.
* Excellent candidate sourcing, screening, negotiation, and communication skills.
* Ability to manage multiple positions and meet recruitment deadlines.
* Strong coordination and stakeholder management skills.

Preferred Candidate Profile

* Candidates who have previously recruited for IT Sales, Cloud Sales, Data Center, System Integration (SI), and Enterprise Solutions companies will be preferred.
* Should be comfortable hiring mid-level and senior-level sales professionals.
* Must be target-oriented, proactive, and capable of handling end-to-end recruitment independently.

**Work Location:** Noida

**Interested candidates can share their updated resumes along with their current CTC, expected CTC, notice period, and current location @**sonali@vensysco.in

Pay: ₹400,000.00 - ₹500,000.00 per year

description:
### **A****BOUT TIDE**

At Tide, we help SMEs save time and money in the running of their businesses by not only offering business accounts and related banking services, but also a comprehensive set of highly usable and connected administrative solutions, from invoicing to accounting.

Tide is transforming the small business banking market and now supports over 2 million members globally across the UK, Germany and France.

Using advanced technology, all solutions are designed with SMEs in mind. With quick onboarding, low fees and innovative features, we thrive on making data driven decisions to serve our mission: to help SMEs save time and money so they can get back to doing what they love.

**Tide facts:**

* Tide is available for UK, German and French SMEs
* Over 2 million members globally and rapidly growing
* Over $300 million raised in funding
* 3,000 Tideans globally
* We have offices in Central London, with a member support and technology centre in Sofia, Bulgaria, technology centres in Serbia, Romania, Lithuania and Hyderabad and offices in Gurugram, New Delhi, Berlin, Paris and Luxembourg

### **ABOUT THE ROLE:**

We're looking for an experienced Product Designer to help shape key areas of the member experience as the Tide app continues to evolve across 55+ products.

At Tide, we approach design with a relentless focus on our members. We love turning the complexity of a chaotic financial world into simple, beautiful and scalable experiences that make running a business easier.

In this role, you'll take ownership of design across high-impact products, working within dedicated cross-functional teams. You'll have significant autonomy to shape the direction of your work, partnering closely with Product and Engineering to balance exceptional member experiences with technical, regulatory and commercial considerations.

We're open to designers operating at Senior, Senior II or Lead level. What matters most is the strength of your craft, the quality of your thinking, your ability to navigate complexity and the impact you've had on the products you've helped build.

If you enjoy solving difficult problems, thinking in systems and creating thoughtful experiences that make a genuine difference to small businesses, we'd love to hear from you.

### **WHAT YOU'LL DO:**

* **Own End-to-End Product Design:** Take ownership of complex product challenges, from early discovery and problem definition through to detailed design and delivery. Create intuitive, engaging experiences that simplify the way our members run their businesses.
* **Shape Product Direction:** Partner closely with Product, Engineering, Data and Operations to understand customer and business needs, challenge assumptions and influence product priorities. Bring a strong design perspective to product strategy, not just execution.
* **Design for Scale and Simplicity:** Translate complex technical requirements, workflows and regulatory constraints into clear, elegant and scalable experiences. Think beyond individual screens to create cohesive journeys across iOS, Android and web.
* **Use Research and Data to Drive Decisions:** Combine qualitative research, quantitative insights, experimentation and product metrics to understand problems, validate solutions and continuously improve the member experience.
* **Set a High Bar for Craft:** Deliver exceptional interaction and visual design, with a sharp eye for typography, layout, usability and detail. Contribute to the evolution of Tide's cross-platform design system and ensure consistency without compromising innovation.
* **Influence and Elevate Design Quality:** Bring clarity to ambiguous challenges, communicate your thinking effectively and collaborate constructively with stakeholders. Share knowledge, provide thoughtful feedback and help raise the quality of design across the wider team.

### **WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR:**

* **Exceptional Product Design Craft:** A strong portfolio demonstrating high-quality, end-to-end product design work, including complex digital products, workflows or systems. We're interested in the problems you've solved, the decisions you've made and the outcomes you've influenced, rather than a specific number of years of experience.
* **Strong Systems Thinking:** The ability to think holistically about products, user journeys and interconnected experiences rather than isolated features or screens. You understand how design decisions scale across platforms, markets and technical or regulatory constraints.
* **Product Thinking and Commercial Awareness:** You connect customer needs with business objectives and understand how good design contributes to meaningful product outcomes. You're comfortable using evidence to inform decisions and making thoughtful trade-offs.
* **Collaboration and Influence:** A proven ability to work effectively within cross-functional teams, build strong relationships and constructively challenge assumptions. You can communicate complex design decisions clearly and bring others along with your thinking.
* **Advanced Interaction and Visual Design:** Strong proficiency in Figma, prototyping and modern design systems, combined with an excellent understanding of interaction patterns, accessibility and the technical implications of your decisions.
* **Autonomy and Comfort with Ambiguity:** You're confident taking ownership of complex challenges, identifying the right problems to solve and creating clarity where requirements aren't always fully defined. You know when to move independently and when to bring others into the conversation.

title: US Healthcare Recruiter-Senior
description:
US Healthcare Recruiter

**Company:** Proxena Health Group LLC  
**Location:** Remote – India  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time Contract / Independent Contractor  
**Compensation:** ₹55,000–₹62,000 per month, depending on experience  
**Initial Engagement:** 30-day paid evaluation contract, with potential for continued engagement based on performance and business requirements.

About Proxena Health Group

Proxena Health Group LLC is a US-based healthcare staffing and workforce solutions company supporting healthcare recruitment and staffing requirements across the United States.

We are seeking an experienced US Healthcare Recruiter based in India to support our growing recruitment operations. The successful candidate will take responsibility for identifying, engaging, screening and preparing qualified healthcare professionals for active US staffing opportunities.

This position requires practical experience in US healthcare agency recruitment, strong candidate-sourcing skills and the ability to work independently using established recruitment resources.

Key Responsibilities

**1. Candidate Sourcing**

* Source qualified US healthcare professionals through established recruitment platforms, job boards, professional networks and existing sourcing resources.
* Identify candidates whose clinical backgrounds align with active job requirements.
* Build and maintain an organised pipeline of potential candidates.
* Prioritise sourcing based on specialty, location, experience, schedule and assignment requirements.

**2. Candidate Outreach and Engagement**

* Contact prospective candidates through email, LinkedIn and telephone.
* Introduce relevant opportunities professionally.
* Establish candidate interest, availability and willingness to consider the assignment.
* Maintain consistent and appropriate follow-up communication.

**3. Resume Screening and Qualification Review**

* Review resumes against specific job descriptions.
* Assess specialty experience, clinical settings, required qualifications and employment history.
* Review applicable licences and certifications.
* Conduct preliminary professional licence checks through appropriate official sources where available.
* Identify missing information or qualification gaps before submission.

**4. Candidate Screening**

* Confirm current employment and candidate availability.
* Establish preferred locations, shifts, schedules and compensation expectations.
* Confirm relocation or travel willingness where relevant.
* Discuss assignment details and determine whether the candidate is genuinely interested.
* Obtain candidate authorisation before submitting their profile.

**5. Submission and Interview Coordination**

* Prepare complete candidate submission packages.
* Provide accurate screening notes and supporting information.
* Coordinate initial interviews and candidate availability.
* Follow up on interview outcomes and outstanding documentation.
* Maintain communication with candidates throughout the recruitment process.

**6. Recruitment Pipeline Management**

* Maintain accurate candidate records and outreach activity.
* Prevent duplicate submissions.
* Provide regular recruitment progress reports.
* Track candidate movement from sourcing through interview and placement stages.

Required Experience and Qualifications

* Minimum three years of hands-on US healthcare staffing recruitment experience.
* Experience recruiting Registered Nurses, Licensed Practical Nurses and allied healthcare professionals.
* Practical knowledge of travel nursing, contract staffing or US healthcare agency recruitment.
* Familiarity with clinical specialties, healthcare facility requirements and US professional licensing.
* Strong resume-screening and candidate-engagement abilities.
* Excellent written and spoken English.
* Good organisational, communication and follow-up skills.
* Ability to work independently in a remote environment.
* Ability to work with an agreed schedule that includes daily overlap with US business hours.

Experience recruiting allied-health professionals, surgical technologists, imaging technologists and other specialist clinical roles is particularly valuable.

Existing Tools and Equipment – Important

This is an independent contractor engagement. Applicants must already have:

* Their own reliable laptop and internet connection.
* A telephone and professional headset.
* Existing access to at least two legitimate candidate-sourcing channels or recruitment databases.
* Practical experience with candidate outreach, recruitment tracking and resume screening.

Please identify the sourcing platforms, databases and recruitment tools you currently have access to when applying.

**Proxena does not require applicants to purchase new software subscriptions for this position.** The role is intended for a recruiter who can independently source candidates using their existing resources and established recruitment methods.

Proxena will provide approved job requirements, candidate screening criteria, submission templates, outreach guidance and a secure process for managing candidate information.

All tools and candidate data must be used in accordance with applicable laws, platform terms and confidentiality requirements.

Working Arrangement

* Fully remote position based in India.
* Full-time working capacity, approximately 40 hours per week.
* Five working days per week, with an agreed daily overlap with US business hours.
* Monthly compensation within the stated range.
* Initial 30-day paid contract evaluation, with the possibility of continued engagement.

Performance Expectations

The initial target is approximately **10 qualified, interested and submission-ready candidates per week across assigned active requisitions**, following the initial onboarding period.

Candidate quality, accurate screening, candidate consent and suitability for the actual role take priority over submission volume.

Performance will be reviewed through weekly recruitment reports, submission quality, candidate engagement, interview progression and overall pipeline development.

How to Apply

Please submit your updated resume and include a brief explanation of:

* Your experience recruiting for US healthcare staffing agencies.
* The clinical specialties and healthcare roles you have recruited for.
* The sourcing platforms and tools you currently have legitimate access to.
* Your typical weekly candidate sourcing and submission capacity.
* Your availability to work with US business-hour overlap.

We are looking for a recruiter who can take ownership of candidate sourcing and delivery, work independently and contribute directly to Proxena's recruitment pipeline.

**Proxena Health Group LLC**  
Healthcare Staffing & Workforce Solutions

Pay: ₹55,000.00 - ₹62,000.00 per month

Work Location: Remote

**Job Description**

**What’s the role?**

As Retail Territory Manager, you are responsible for managing the relationship between Shell and Retailer/Dealer at site level through the S&O pillars of Care for People, Brilliant Basics & Site P&L, and ensuring consistent delivery of the Safe operations, Shell’s Customer promises, and profitability of a cluster of 15 to 20 sites.

**What you’ll be doing**

* Identify Gaps in all aspects of site performance (including service and 'people') for responsible geographical area and mandate, advice or offer Retailer/Dealers Shell-recommended tools, processes and support to help them to profitably deliver the Customer Commitment at the Retail site and to develop the business for the mutual benefit of both the Retailer/Dealer and Shell.
* Maximize all sales development potential whilst protecting Shell's interests, through the coaching and motivating of Retailer/Dealer.
* Manage and maintain positive Retailer/Dealer relationships, supporting them to achieve and maintain top class site performance (including counselling and performance management of underperforming sites / Retailers).

* Play a leading role in implementing the local retail strategy in order to secure the best possible network coverage while maximizing the shareholder interests.
* Ensure that Dealers' and retailers actions do not damage Shell's Reputation.
Ensure that the retailers trains and develops their staff and understands the importance of people in delivering the Customer Commitment.  

**What you bring**

We’re keen to hear from individuals with extensive relevant experience and with the following skills experience, and knowledge:

* Selling and Negotiation.
* Channel Management.
* Applying Customer Value Proposition.
* Commercial & Economic Acumen.
* Managing Customer Experience.
* Retail Site Operations.
Value Chain Understanding.  

Beyond that, we’d like to see the following on your CV:

* Proven experience in delivering P&L roles – Topline, Margins, Cost, Losses.
* Eye for Detail through setting high benchmark on site operations, HSSE, housekeeping, grooming standards, training, evaluations.
* Ability to grow Site Incomes with equal focus in developing Partner (Retailer) capabilities in a rapidly growing network.
* Competent to lead & deliver the NFR aspirations from every site; with specific focus on driving a professional Convenience Retail business. High quality "Eye for Detail" - Daily Operations.
* Ability to be self-motivated, bringing enormous amount of energy & positive attitude - every day.
Ability to passionately demonstrating the "People Make the Difference Real" spirit.  

**What we offer**

You bring your skills and experience to Shell and in return you work with talented, committed people on one of the most important challenges facing our planet. You’ll have the opportunity to develop the skills you need to grow in an environment where we value honesty, integrity, and respect for one another. You’ll be able to balance your priorities as you become the best version of yourself.

* Progress as a person as we work on the energy transition together.
* Continuously grow the transferable skills you need to get ahead.
* Work at the forefront of technology, trends, and practices.
* Collaborate with experienced colleagues with unique expertise.
* Achieve your balance in a values-led culture that encourages you to be the best version of yourself.
* Benefit from flexible working hours, and the possibility of remote/mobile working.
* Perform at your best with a competitive starting salary and annual performance related salary increase – our pay and benefits packages are considered to be among the best in the world.
* Take advantage of paid parental leave, including for non-birthing parents.
* Join an organisation working to become one of the most diverse and inclusive in the world. We strongly encourage applicants of all genders, ages, ethnicities, cultures, abilities, sexual orientation, and life experiences to apply.
* Grow as you progress through diverse career opportunities in national and
* international teams.
Gain access to a wide range of training and development programmes.  

**We'd like you to know that Shell has a bold goal: to become one of the world’s most diverse and inclusive companies. You can get to know more about how we're working towards that goal,****.**

**IMPORTANT NOTICE: After you submit your application, you will receive an email providing a link to an online assessment that is a mandatory part of the process. The email will come from HireVue - please check your spam/junk mailbox if you do not see the email. Once completed, your application will be reviewed to determine next steps. Thank you for your interest in Shell.**



**Shell in India**

  

Shell is a diversified energy company in India with 13,000 employees, and presence in Integrated Gas, Downstream, Power, Renewable and Upstream. Additionally, we have deep capabilities in R&D, digitalization, and business operations.

  

Our global strategy, Powering Progress, is designed to generate value for our shareholders, customers, and the wider society, and focuses on creating more value with less emissions. The strategy supports our purpose of providing more and cleaner energy solutions, with the aim of profitably transforming Shell into a net-zero emissions energy business by 2050. As India moves towards its target of net-zero emissions by 2070, Shell India aims to play a leading role in securing vital energy for today, while investing in, and helping to build, the energy system of the future through strategic investments in the country.

  

Our Lubricants business serves over 50,000 consumers through a strong network of over 200 distributors, and operates an end-to-end value chain that spans conceptualization, development, and production at a world-class blending plant at Taloja. Through our 350-plus retail stations, we offer an integrated mobility experience including fuels, cafes, and convenience stores, with a prominent network of EV recharging facilities.

  

Shell owns and operates an LNG re-gasification terminal at Hazira, Surat, with a capacity of 5 MTPA and an LNG truck-loading unit that plays a crucial role in helping meet India’s growing demand for gas across sectors. In 2022, Shell acquired Spring Energy in a $1.55 billion deal to build an integrated energy transition business in the country. Spring is a leading renewable energy company in India which develops and manages solar, wind, and hybrid power generation facilities and infrastructure.

  

Our three capability centers across Bangalore and Chennai serve as a technology and innovation powerhouse for Shell globally, working as a delivery engine for core technical, digital, and finance processes: pioneering digital innovation and cutting-edge technologies across the energy sector. We also have strong academic partnerships and collaborations with leading universities and technology institutes to accelerate decarbonization efforts within the energy sector.

  

We are committed to positively contributing to the communities in which we operate through programs on STEM Education, Skilling, and Livelihood across India. We nurture and invest in startups developing initiatives focused on accelerating energy innovation through programs such as Shell E4 and Shell Eco-marathon. We also have strategic investments in new energy companies such as Husk Power, d.light, Orb Energy, and Cleantech Solar.

Please note: We occasionally amend or withdraw Shell jobs and reserve the right to do so at any time, including prior to the advertised closing date. Before applying, you are advised to read our data protection policy. This policy describes the processing that may be associated with your personal data and informs you that your personal data may be transferred to Shell/Shell Group companies around the world. The Shell Group and its approved recruitment consultants will never ask you for a fee to process or consider your application for a career with Shell. Anyone who demands such a fee is not an authorised Shell representative and you are strongly advised to refuse any such demand. Shell is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

**A. Manpower Planning & Recruitment Coordination**

* Coordinate with department heads and hiring managers to understand current and future manpower requirements.
* Obtain approved Manpower Requisition Forms (MRFs) before initiating recruitment.
* Understand job descriptions, role requirements, qualifications, experience and competencies required for each position.
* Maintain an updated tracker of open positions and recruitment priorities.

**B. Sourcing & Talent Acquisition**

* Source candidates through various channels, including:
* Job portals such as Naukri, LinkedIn, Indeed, etc.
* Employee referrals.
* Social media platforms and professional networks.
* Recruitment consultants and placement agencies.
* Internal databases and previous applicants.
* Identify and build a pipeline of suitable candidates for current and future requirements.
* Proactively headhunt candidates for specialised and critical positions.
* Explore innovative sourcing methods to improve the quality and speed of hiring.

**C. Screening & Interview Management**

* Screen resumes against the defined job specifications.
* Conduct preliminary telephonic or virtual interviews to assess candidate suitability.
* Evaluate candidates on qualifications, experience, communication skills, compensation expectations and cultural fit.
* Schedule interviews and coordinate with hiring managers and interview panels.
* Follow up with interviewers to obtain timely feedback.
* Maintain proper documentation and records of shortlisted and rejected candidates.

**D. Offer Management & Closure**

* Coordinate salary discussions and negotiations with selected candidates within approved budgets.
* Ensure timely release of offer letters in coordination with HR.
* Follow up with selected candidates for offer acceptance and joining confirmation.
* Maintain regular communication with candidates during the notice period to minimise offer dropouts.
* Conduct pre-joining follow-ups and ensure candidates join on the committed date.

**E. Onboarding & Joining Formalities**

* Coordinate with the HR Operations team for completion of joining formalities.
* Ensure collection of required documents and completion of pre-employment formalities.
* Coordinate induction and joining schedules.
* Maintain joining records and recruitment-related documentation.

**F. Recruitment MIS & Reporting**

* Maintain an updated recruitment tracker covering:
* Open positions and ageing of vacancies.
* Number of resumes sourced and shortlisted.
* Interviews scheduled and conducted.
* Selection and offer status.
* Offer acceptance and joining ratio.
* Source-wise recruitment effectiveness.
* Prepare weekly and monthly recruitment reports.
* Monitor recruitment turnaround time and highlight delays or bottlenecks.
* Track recruitment costs and consultant performance.

**G. Candidate Relationship Management**

* Ensure a positive candidate experience throughout the recruitment process.
* Maintain regular communication with candidates and provide timely updates.
* Build and maintain a database of potential candidates for future requirements.
* Ensure confidentiality and professional handling of candidate information.

* Verify invoices, payment entries, and supporting documents.
* Ensure payments and collections are properly recorded and tracked.

**6. Statutory Compliance & Administration**

* Maintain company financial and statutory records.
* Track due dates for GST, TDS, PF, ESI, and other applicable compliances.

* Maintain proper documentation for audits and inspections.

* Excellent reconciliation, reporting, and documentation skills.
* Ability to independently manage multiple responsibilities and meet deadlines.
* Strong communication and coordination skills.

* Opportunity to work closely with company management and handle end-to-end financial operations.
* Long-term growth opportunity within an expanding manufacturing business.

We are looking for someone who is highly responsible, trustworthy, organized, and capable of independently handling the company's complete accounting and financial operations.

Candidates who have previously managed accounts, GST, payroll, vendor payments, compliance, and MIS in a manufacturing or industrial company will be preferred.

**If you have the experience and ability to take ownership of finance, accounts, and administrative operations, we invite you to apply to Swastik Steel.**
